title: Studio field inspector shows the expression editor only on a formula field, so an author cannot follow the new remedy (a number/date field with the same expression) without hand-editing metadata (#32443 follow-up)
body:
domain:spec#4 · marchtian · session_017ihL2gENvvRYHmL5nFTF5x

Filing gate: ② measured gap, from #32443's decision analysis (`/mnt/project-files/issue-32443/decision-analysis.md`). The finding comes from reading the code; it was not checked in a browser. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade.
Reader: `domain:ui`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx`. The expression editor is gated on `type === 'formula'` at ~line 1622.
Dedupe: no open card names the inspector and a stored field's `expression`.
reach: after PR #32545 (route 1 of #32443, ruled B by 田騏 2026-11-12, ruling of record 6816315099), the refusal of `sum` / `avg` over a formula tells the author to make the value a field of its return type (`number`, `date`, …) carrying the same `expression`. That field is computed and stored on every write. A person in Studio cannot do this: the inspector offers the expression editor only on a `formula` field, so a `number` field shows no place to write one. Only an AI author or hand-written metadata can follow the remedy.
Blocked-by: #32443

## Ask

Offer the expression editor on stored field types that accept an `expression`. The spec's `expression` contract on non-formula fields says which types those are. Show the field as computed and read-only once an expression is set. Pin a `number` field with an expression saving and round-tripping through the inspector. Check it in the browser.
